title: README, docs and screenshots for the new design

spec.phase: Phase UI — Studio design and UX (release 3.0.0)
spec.summary: The README's screenshots show the media studio before Phase 2 and before this redesign, and the README and docs don't describe the timeline features added since 2.10.0 (tracks, edit tools, picture-in-picture, keyframes, transitions, speed, audio tracks, voice-over, saved projects). 507 retakes every screenshot with a script so they can be taken again at each release, updates the README's feature list and pictures, and updates `docs/MEDIA-STUDIO.md`, `docs/DESIGN.md` and the in-app docs (`src/data/docs.ts`) to the new design.

US-1.text: As someone finding Chitthi on GitHub, I want screenshots and a feature list that show what the app does today.

US-2.text: As a maintainer, I want screenshots made by a script, so that they stay current with one command.

AC-1.text: `npm run screenshots` opens the production build with sample projects (no photos of people, per the sample-photo rule) and writes every README and docs screenshot as WebP to `docs/screenshots/`, in the light theme and, for the phone shot, the dark theme; it runs on web without the desktop app.

AC-2.text: The README lists the features of the photo, Reel and YouTube modes as of this phase (multi-track timeline, edit tools, picture-in-picture, keyframes, transitions, speed, audio tracks and ducking, voice-over, saved projects, the media pool) with new screenshots, each with alt text that describes it; no screenshot is older than this phase.

AC-3.text: `docs/MEDIA-STUDIO.md`, `docs/DESIGN.md` and the in-app docs describe the new layout, folding panels, media pool, Recordings and Layers; every link checks out.

Q1.text: Scripted screenshots? _Answer (accepted 2026-10-20):_ yes, a Playwright script (`scripts/screenshots.mjs`, Playwright is already a devDependency) with sample projects in `tests/support/`.

changelog.text: Created: draft spec with 3 acceptance criteria and 1 open questions with proposed answers (Phase UI, D-063).
Every proposed answer accepted by the maintainer; Approved.

sections.title: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.markdown:
- **Licences:** sample media used in screenshots is cleared in `specs/licensing.md` and credited.
- **Size:** each screenshot ≤ 300 KB.
